name: Hue Citadel
kicker: Walled imperial court on the north bank
summary: The walled court of the Nguyễn kings, about 600 m a side inside the outer citadel on the north bank. Walk in through Ngọ Môn, the king’s gate, past Thái Hòa palace and the ancestral temples to the Forbidden Purple City and the Duyệt Thị Đường theatre. Give it the morning, at opening: it is the heart of the Hue monuments.
getThere: Walk from the south bank over Phu Xuan or Truong Tien Bridge.
heroCaption: Ngọ Môn, the king's gate, from the front

notice.title: The 200,000 VND ticket is the Imperial City only
notice.body: Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh are separate tickets, or buy the four-site ticket: 530,000 VND for an adult and 100,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12, valid two days from the first visit. An Dinh, Hon Chen, Nam Giao, and the Museum of Royal Antiquities have their own tickets. Thien Mu is not on the fee table.

body: Enter at the ticketed Imperial City. The centre describes the outer citadel as about 10 km around, with walls about 6.6 m high, and the Imperial City inside it at about 600 m a side. Ngọ Môn was the king’s gate. Beyond it the courts run to the Thái Hòa palace, the ancestral temples, and the Forbidden Purple City, built in 1804, with the Duyệt Thị Đường theatre.

The adult ticket is 200,000 VND, the same for international and Vietnamese visitors. A child from 7 to 12 pays 40,000 VND, and under 7 is free. If the tombs are on your plan, the four-site ticket costs less than the four single tickets.

Go at opening: 06:30 from 16 March to 15 October, 07:00 from 16 October to 15 March. Ticket sales close at 17:30 in summer and 17:00 in winter. The ticket site offers an audio guide and an electric cart.

figures.caption: Thái Hòa palace across the water, inside the Imperial City
figures.alt: The yellow-roofed Thái Hòa palace seen across a pool from a painted gate inside the Hue Imperial City

gettingThere: The Imperial City sits inside the outer citadel on the north bank. Walk from the south bank over Phu Xuan Bridge, or over Truong Tien Bridge, where the river path starts.

legs.heading: From the south bank
legs.body: Walk across Phu Xuan Bridge or Truong Tien Bridge.

hours: 16 Mar–15 Oct: 06:30–18:00, tickets until 17:30. 16 Oct–15 Mar: 07:00–17:30, tickets until 17:00 (conservation centre notice, 12 Mar 2024). Confirm the board on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day on the centre’s notice.
admissionNote: Adult 200,000 VND, the same price for an international visitor and a Vietnamese visitor. A child from 7 to 12 pays 40,000 VND. Under 7 is free. Hue residents and the other groups named in Resolution 55/2025/NQ-HĐND pay half. The ticket is the Imperial City only. The four-site ticket, Imperial City plus Minh Mang, Tu Duc, and Khai Dinh, is 530,000 VND for an adult and 100,000 VND for a child from 7 to 12, for up to two days from the first visit. Audio guide and electric cart: Check on arrival.
